summary: Replication gate runs hypothesis-card predictions as fixed in-sample tests (Holm within the card) before any criterion/backtest; a contradicted prediction refuses admission; mechanism_support is recorded and feeds persona evidence_quality; no testable prediction is admitted as mechanism_untested.

acceptance.1: mechanism_tests.run_mechanism_stage, called first in ReplicationGate.evaluate_candidate; tests test_event_window_on_recorded_ex_dividend_events_is_measured, test_regime_split_on_recorded_0050_200_day_mean_is_measured, test_default_alpha_is_five_percent_and_holm_is_within_the_card
acceptance.2: test_contradicted_prediction_refuses_admission_with_recorded_reason (primary criteria compared with a baseline run)
acceptance.5: test_mechanism_stage_reads_no_out_of_sample_bar and test_no_out_of_sample_bar_with_unequal_lengths_and_staggered_starts: poison boundaries derived from the protocol rule (split_idx=int(min target bars*ratio), every instrument sliced by that index, as vectorbt_adapter) not from InSampleMarket; InSampleMarket now shares that window rule incl. target universe; plus test_mechanism_stage_runs_before_the_backtest_and_the_backtest_is_not_used_by_it; R3: test_screened_unequal_pool_histories_read_no_out_of_sample_bar_at_gate_entry (gate entry, screened artifact, shorter pool member; fails without the fix)
acceptance.6: fixtures/recorded_mechanism_tw.json: recorded TWSE STOCK_DAY (2330, 2317, 0050, 2024-01..2026-10) and TWT49U ex-dividend rows with URLs and response sha256; test_production_module_synthesizes_no_data

production_path: ReplicationGate.evaluate_candidate (gate.py) <- AlphaRevalidationWorker (revalidation_worker.py forwards hypothesis_predictions/mechanism_inputs/dataset); integration tests in tests/test_gate_mechanism.py and test_revalidation_worker.py::test_real_gate_records_mechanism_status_on_the_run
verification: pytest services/research/replication services/control-plane/persona/test_persona_strategy_discovery.py services/research/alpha_replication/test_revalidation_worker.py -q -> 130 passed in 241.10s, exit 0 (R3 fix)
known_limits: Real recorded events (14 in-sample ex-dividend events) are too few to reach alpha 0.05: the recorded-data tests pin the measured inconclusive result; supported/contradicted admission tests loosen only mechanism_alpha (named in the test module). Default 0.05 is pinned.
No historical monthly-revenue release dates exist on TWSE/MOPS endpoints, so the event_window recording uses the ex-dividend calendar.
0050 prices before its 2025-06-18 4-for-1 split are divided by 4 by the test helper (recorded in fixture provenance).
Carrying predictions from the compiled spec into hypothesis_predictions is not part of this task; the worker forwards them when the spec carries them.
r2_fix: Reopen P1: per-instrument earliest-date cutoff leaked protocol-OOS bars of longer instruments (65 0050 bars, 69 2317 bars on the reproduction). Fixed by sharing the protocol window; pinned event-window stats re-measured (t=-0.9711, p=0.3492).
r3_fix: Reopen P1 (PR #7257): gate._run_mechanism_stage derived targets from artifact.parameters.symbols even for screened artifacts, while vectorbt_adapter uses the whole candidate_pool_market.symbols universe, so a shorter pool member shifted the protocol split and the stage read protocol-OOS bars. Fixed: screened artifacts (strategy_logic has 'screen') use the pool symbols as target universe; unscreened path unchanged.
